title: •Force Push
caption: •Force Push (V)
game_text: During battle, use 2 Force to target your Dark Jedi and opponent’s character of equal or lesser ability present. Both targets are excluded from battle. OR Exchange two cards from hand with any one card from Force Pile; reshuffle.
lore: A fully-trained Sith warrior has more weapons at his disposal than just a lightsaber.

notes: Sheet group: Everything else (Dark Side). Unique. Printed card is a Used Interrupt; slip banner OUT OF PLAY INTERRUPT. Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. One credit line printed below the text box (left, italic): 'Original concept by North Dakota States Players, 2006' → credit_bottom (single string, as vs13/07). Slip text matches the stub. Printed text was 'Target opponent’s Jedi with at least one combat card present with your Dark Jedi. … (Immune to Sense.)'. Lore matches the wiki. Ring icons right of the lore box on the printed card: Reflections III sphere and the black EPISODE I disc → ring_icons ['episode1'].
